p: Ridley remains with the team in normal status despite the airport incident.
The incident is with law enforcement, so a discipline or availability risk is unresolved, though Saleh described it as minor.
it was a very minor miscommunication at the airport.
Ridley is doing some good things but Saleh expects more production.
Mild criticism of the WR1 suggests his production is not yet where the coaching staff wants it.
Still expect more from both of them.
